mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% consistently predicts positive S&P 500 5-day returns as accommodative monetary policy compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals economic distress that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0) signals deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns through reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of instances when both UNRATE > 9.0 and INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) triggers negative S&P 500 20-day returns due to reduced real cash flows and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 550.0 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through elevated corporate revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high housing starts (HOUST > 550.0) and strong real sales (RSAFS > 380000) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST > 550.0 and RSAFS > 380000.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 90.0 (INDPRO < 90.0) signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 60-day returns through reduced corporate output and earnings forecasts.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Real sales exceeding 385,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 385000) indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through elevated economic activity and corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 385000.
